title: PharmaRAG-GNN
summary: explainable hybrid framework integrating knowledge-graph retrieval-augmented generation (rag) with graph neural networks (gnns) to predict drug–drug interactions (ddis).

caseFile.problem: predicting drug–drug interactions (ddis) is critical for clinical safety, yet pure black-box neural models struggle to explain why two compounds interact, while standalone retrieval systems miss structural patterns across pharmacological graphs.
caseFile.approach: combined structured pharmacological knowledge graphs with retrieval-augmented generation and graph neural network message passing. the graph encoder captures molecular and relational topology, while graph-grounded rag retrieves supporting interaction pathways and context.
caseFile.architecture: a dual-pathway pipeline: structured pharmacological triples feed both a gnn interaction predictor and a knowledge-graph retriever, merging structural embeddings with retrieved evidence for explainable ddi predictions.
caseFile.learned: grounding neural predictions in an explicit knowledge graph makes model outputs inspectable rather than opaque, and cleanly separating retrieval from graph inference keeps the system modular.

title: LearnSphere Smart Campus Assistant
summary: ai-powered academic assistant for document processing (pdf, docx, pptx), rag-based contextual q&a, auto-generated quizzes, flashcards, and learning analytics.

caseFile.problem: students juggle dense lecture decks, pdfs, and notes across folders without an easy way to query across materials or turn them into active recall practice.
caseFile.approach: built a lightweight academic workspace supporting pdf, docx, pptx, and txt ingestion with folder organization, jwt-protected routes, rag-powered chat, and automated quiz and flashcard generation.
caseFile.architecture: flask backend with flask-jwt-extended and sqlite for user and folder metadata, paired with pdfplumber and python-docx extractors, sentence-transformers embeddings, chromadb vector storage, and openai api synthesis.
caseFile.learned: combining structured document metadata in sqlite with vector retrieval in chromadb makes multi-file academic search both fast and predictable.

title: Agromart
summary: full-stack ai crop disease predictor powered by resnet50 deep learning, achieving 92% early diagnosis accuracy.

caseFile.problem: delayed identification of crop diseases leads to preventable yield loss, especially when growers lack quick access to lab diagnostics.
caseFile.approach: trained a resnet50 deep learning classifier on crop leaf imagery and wrapped it in an accessible javascript web interface for instant disease screening.
caseFile.architecture: javascript frontend capturing leaf images and displaying treatment-oriented predictions served from a python resnet50 inference pipeline.
caseFile.learned: transfer learning with resnet50 delivers 92% early diagnosis accuracy while keeping inference lightweight enough for responsive web delivery.

title: SoulShine
summary: ai-powered mental health monitoring system using neural networks and the gemini api to analyze user emotions and provide personalized insights.

caseFile.problem: mental wellness tracking tools often feel static and fail to adapt feedback to a user's shifting emotional state.
caseFile.approach: paired a neural-network emotion analysis layer with the gemini api to interpret user check-ins and surface calm, personalized reflections.
caseFile.architecture: javascript application layer handling daily emotional check-ins, connected to neural emotion classification and gemini-powered insight generation.
caseFile.learned: combining structured emotion classification with generative synthesis produces much more grounded and empathetic feedback than raw prompting alone.

title: Breast Cancer Predictor
summary: real-time breast cancer prediction web app built with scikit-learn and a streamlit ui, achieving 85% prediction accuracy.

caseFile.problem: clinical ml prototypes often stay locked inside notebooks, making it hard for non-technical users to test feature inputs interactively.
caseFile.approach: built a clean scikit-learn classification pipeline and exposed real-time predictions through an interactive streamlit interface.
caseFile.architecture: python data preprocessing and trained classifier served directly inside a reactive streamlit web dashboard.
caseFile.learned: rapidly packaging an 85%-accuracy ml model into a clean interactive ui makes validation and feature sensitivity checks dramatically faster.

title: FlyHigh (Online Flight Booking)
summary: online flight ticket booking system built with reactjs and spring boot featuring secure transactions and payment gateway integration.

caseFile.problem: flight reservation systems require consistent seat inventory, reliable booking state transitions, and secure payment handling.
caseFile.approach: designed a full-stack booking flow separating a responsive reactjs frontend from transactional spring boot rest services and relational sql storage.
caseFile.architecture: reactjs ui communicating with spring boot controllers, payment gateway integration, and relational sql tables for flights, passengers, and tickets.
caseFile.learned: strict transactional boundaries in spring boot are essential to prevent double-booking and keep payment confirmation in sync with seat state.

title: EduGo
summary: personalized learning platform built with bootstrap and css, helping students discover the best teachers through ai-based recommendations.

caseFile.problem: students searching for tutors face noisy directories without personalized matching to their learning pace and subject needs.
caseFile.approach: created a clean, responsive learning portal paired with ai-based teacher recommendations tailored to student preferences.
caseFile.architecture: responsive html, css, and bootstrap frontend integrated with a recommendation layer ranking teachers by student fit.
caseFile.learned: clear information hierarchy and focused filtering matter just as much as the underlying recommendation logic.
